title: VeloxClarity
description: VeloxClarity is a lightweight, client-side Fabric mod designed for PvP players who want cleaner visuals and better combat readability — without crossing into cheat territory.
body:
# ✨ VeloxClarity

> **A lightweight client-side visual enhancement mod for Minecraft Fabric 1.21.11.**
> Built for players who want a cleaner screen, better visibility, and zero unnecessary distractions.

---

# 🎯 Why VeloxClarity?

Minecraft's default visual effects can often get in the way—especially during PvP, parkour, or fast-paced gameplay.

**VeloxClarity** removes visual clutter while keeping the game completely vanilla-friendly. Every feature is purely cosmetic and runs entirely on your client.

**No cheats. No exploits. No packet modifications.**
Just a cleaner and more comfortable Minecraft experience.

Open the configuration menu anytime by pressing **B**, enable only the features you want, and all settings will be saved automatically.

---

# ⚡ 24 Individual Features

Every option can be enabled or disabled independently.

---

## 🛡️ Overlay Improvements

| Feature                  | Description                                                                 |
| ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 🔥 No Fire Overlay       | Removes the first-person fire overlay for maximum visibility while burning. |
| 🔥 Low Fire              | Lowers the fire animation so it no longer blocks your crosshair.            |
| 🌀 No Portal Overlay     | Removes Nether Portal distortion.                                           |
| 🎃 No Pumpkin Overlay    | Removes the carved pumpkin screen overlay.                                  |
| ❄️ No Powder Snow        | Removes the freezing vignette effect.                                       |
| 🌊 No Underwater Overlay | Removes underwater distortion.                                              |
| 🌑 No Vignette           | Removes dark screen edges.                                                  |
| 🔭 No Spyglass Overlay   | Removes the spyglass frame.                                                 |

---

## 🎥 Camera

| Feature            | Description                                                       |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 💥 No Hurt Camera  | Removes camera shake when taking damage.                          |
| 🚶 No View Bobbing | Disables walking camera movement.                                 |
| 🎯 Static FOV      | Prevents FOV changes caused by sprinting, bows, or speed effects. |

---

## ✨ Effect Removal

| Feature                    | Description                                   |
| -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| 🤢 No Nausea               | Removes nausea distortion.                    |
| 🌑 No Darkness             | Removes the Darkness visual effect.           |
| 🫧 Hide Negative Particles | Hides particles from negative status effects. |

---

## 👁️ Visual Enhancements

| Feature            | Description                              |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------- |
| 💡 FullBright      | Maximum brightness in every dimension.   |
| 🌧️ No Weather     | Hides rain and snow particles.           |
| 🌫️ No Fog         | Removes distance fog.                    |
| ✨ No Enchant Glint | Removes the enchantment glow from items. |

---

## 📊 HUD Options

| Feature          | Description                        |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| 📋 No Scoreboard | Hides the sidebar scoreboard.      |
| 👑 No Boss Bar   | Hides boss health bars.            |
| 📝 No Titles     | Hides title and subtitle messages. |
| 💬 No Action Bar | Hides action bar notifications.    |

---

## ⚙️ Miscellaneous

| Feature                     | Description                                     |
| --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| 📷 No Screen Shake          | Removes all remaining camera shake effects.     |
| 🔄 No Item Switch Animation | Removes the hand animation when changing items. |

---

# 🖥️ Modern Configuration Menu

Press **B** to open the built-in GUI.

The menu includes:

* 🎨 Clean modern interface
* 📂 Organized categories
* 📑 Two-column layout
* 💬 Helpful tooltips
* ✅ Enable All button
* ❌ Disable All button
* 🔊 Optional interface sounds
* ⚡ Instant opening with no blur or lag

Every setting is saved automatically.

---

# 🌍 Language Support

VeloxClarity automatically detects your Minecraft language.

Supported languages:

* 🇺🇸 English
* 🇷🇺 Русский

---

# 🛡️ Multiplayer & Anti-Cheat Safe

VeloxClarity is **100% client-side**.

It never modifies gameplay mechanics, communicates with servers, or sends custom packets.

**This mod does NOT include:**

* ❌ Aim Assist
* ❌ Kill Aura
* ❌ Auto Clicker
* ❌ Reach
* ❌ Velocity
* ❌ ESP
* ❌ Tracers
* ❌ X-Ray
* ❌ Packet exploits
* ❌ Server-side modifications

Every feature affects **only what you see on your own screen**.

---

# 📥 Installation

1. Install **Fabric Loader**.
2. Install **Fabric API**.
3. Place **VeloxClarity.jar** into your `mods` folder.
4. Launch Minecraft.
5. Press **B** to customize the mod.

---

# 🚀 Performance

VeloxClarity is designed to be extremely lightweight.

✔ Minimal memory usage

✔ Negligible CPU usage

✔ Fast GUI

✔ No unnecessary rendering

✔ Optimized for long multiplayer sessions

---

# 📋 Compatibility

* Minecraft **1.21.11**
* Fabric Loader
* Client-side
* Singleplayer
* Multiplayer
